articles.headline: Celtic, Rangers Scottish Cup games to be played behind closed doors after fan trouble
articles.description: Celtic and Rangers have both been ordered to play their next home Scottish Cup match behind closed doors.

images.name: Ibrox scrap [1296x729]
images.caption: Police intervene as fans come into proximity with players.
images.alt: Police intervene as a fan approaches Celtic's Tomas Cvancara at full time and the during a Scottish Gas Scottish Cup Quarter-Final match between Rangers and Celtic at Ibrox Stadium.
images.credit: Photo by Craig Foy/SNS Group via Getty Images.

articles.headline: Rangers to face Celtic in Premier Sports Cup quarterfinals after Derek McInnes gets off the mark
articles.description: Rangers were handed a home tie against Old Firm rivals Celtic in the Premier Sports Cup quarterfinal draw after getting their first win under new boss Derek McInnes at the fifth time of asking when they beat St Mirren 5-1 at Ibrox.

images.name: Derek McInnes [1296x729]
images.caption: Derek McInnes finally got his first win as Rangers manager against St Mirren.
images.alt: Rangers Manager Derek McInnes during a Premier Sports Cup Second Round match between Rangers and St Mirren at Ibrox Stadium, on August 16, 2026, in Glasgow, Scotland.
images.credit: Rob Casey/SNS Group via Getty Images

articles.headline: Police say big away fan groups 'not safe' for Old Firm derby
articles.description: Large away supporter groups in games between Rangers and Celtic have been described as unsafe by the police officer in charge of investigating Sunday's Ibrox trouble.

articles.headline: Arrests made as Scottish police hit out at 'shameful' scenes after Celtic vs. Rangers
articles.description: Police stated they faced "extreme hostility and violence" during a post-match pitch invasion at Ibrox which impacted Celtic staff and players.

articles.headline: Chaos at Ibrox as fans clash after Celtic knock Rangers out of Scottish Cup
articles.description: Fans clashed on the Ibrox pitch after Celtic knocked Rangers out of the Scottish Cup on penalties on Sunday.
